periods.occupation: student knight; student council general affairs member

status.current: eliminated earlier by Ikki but supports the final selection

relationships.toka-todo: Student council president who scolds Renren's messiness and casual dress.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former opponent; cheers him at the gate and tells him to show the guts worthy of beating her.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Bonds with her over unidentified-creature enthusiasm and badminton.

periods.summary: Renren adds the student council's rowdy energy: she plays badminton with Stella, lazes in the student council room in underwear, asks for snacks, and shares Stella's enthusiasm for the supposed giant. On the final day she joins the crowd gathered by Shizuku to support Ikki, reminding him that he beat her and must show his resolve.

key_events.summary: Appears in the chaotic student council meeting and joins the giant search setup.
Teams with Ikazuchi during the mountain search and greets the returning group.
Cheers Ikki before the final duel.

abilities: Runner's High speed ability referenced by title
